title: Ensure system wide crypto policy disables sha1 hash and signature support
objective: Audit CIS checkpoint 1.6.3: Ensure system wide crypto policy disables sha1 hash and signature support

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

fields.name: cis_result_comment
fields.description: Raw output of the crypto policy checks (step-02 and step-03 results)

fields.name: cis_raw_output
fields.description: Raw output of the crypto policy checks (step-02 and step-03 results) for troubleshooting

steps.name: Check if the system-wide crypto policy file exists
steps.function: 1. Check if the system-wide crypto policy file exists using command: `test -f /etc/crypto-policies/state/CURRENT.pol`. Expected result: exit status 0 (file exists).

steps.name: Check that the hash and sign lines do not include SHA1 (excluding commented lines)
steps.function: 2. Check that the hash and sign lines do not include SHA1 (excluding commented lines) using command: `awk -F= '($1~/(hash|sign)/ && $2~/SHA1/ && $2!~/^\s*-\s*([^#\n\r]+)?SHA1/){print}' /etc/crypto-policies/state/CURRENT.pol`. Expected result: no output (nothing returned).

steps.name: Check that sha1_in_certs is set to 0 (disabled)
steps.function: 3. Check that sha1_in_certs is set to 0 (disabled) using command: `grep -Psi -- '^\h*sha1_in_certs\h*=\h*' /etc/crypto-policies/state/CURRENT.pol`. Expected result: output contains `sha1_in_certs = 0`.

steps.name: Check overall compliance status: PASS if all above checks pass, SKIP if the policy file does not exist, FAIL if the…
steps.function: 4. Check overall compliance status: PASS if all above checks pass, SKIP if the policy file does not exist, FAIL if the file exists but SHA1 hash/sign support is enabled or sha1_in_certs is not 0.

steps.name: Store the final audit result in a variable named 'cis_result' using set_fact. Set cis_result to the overall compliance…
steps.function: 5. Store the final audit result in a variable named 'cis_result' using set_fact. Set cis_result to the overall compliance status (PASS/FAIL/SKIP/ERROR) derived from the last requirement's status variable. Also store the raw output of step-02 and step-03 in cis_result_comment and cis_raw_output.
